powerEngDiscoveries.title: LROC Illumination Survey Complete
powerEngDiscoveries.finding: Shackleton rim: 86% mean solar illumination over 2-year LRO baseline. Optimal VSAT array placement confirmed at ridge crest.

powerEngDiscoveries.title: VSAT Array Efficiency Baseline
powerEngDiscoveries.finding: 4 × 10 kW vertical solar arrays producing 45 kW peak at 1.5° sun elevation. GaAs triple-junction cells operating at nominal efficiency.
powerEngDiscoveries.source: NASA Langley NTRS 20210011743 — Kerslake et al. 2021

powerEngDiscoveries.title: SEP Proton Flux Detected
powerEngDiscoveries.finding: Solar energetic particle event: 10 MeV proton fluence detected. GaAs photovoltaic lattice displacement damage estimated at 5% output loss.
powerEngDiscoveries.source: GaAs proton damage model, Sumita et al. 2003; VSAT specs NTRS 20210011743

powerEngDiscoveries.title: CME Grid Report Filed
powerEngDiscoveries.finding: Class-X storm aftermath: Faraday isolation protocol held. Fission reactor maintained 12 kW through storm. Solar arrays de-rated 5% from SEP damage. All bus circuits nominal.
powerEngDiscoveries.source: NASA KRUSTY (Kilopower) + DONKI CME data + NTRS VSAT specs

powerEngDiscoveries.title: Battery Efficiency Measured
powerEngDiscoveries.finding: 500 kWh solid-state battery bank cycle efficiency: 94%. Deep-cycle charge retained through all 3 dark intervals. BVAD life support power draw within budget.
powerEngDiscoveries.source: NASA BVAD Table 4.1 (NASA/TP-2015-218570); Battery GM-02 performance

powerEngDiscoveries.title: 90-Day Power Budget Projection
powerEngDiscoveries.finding: Mission total generation: 12,960 kWh solar + 25,920 kWh fission = 38,880 kWh. Margin: POSITIVE. Full power budget submitted to Houston.
powerEngDiscoveries.source: NASA Langley VSAT + KRUSTY Kilopower; BVAD total crew consumption
